shared_elements: schematic human or human-like figure/body parts
justification: The strongest correspondence is that both surfaces combine schematic relief animal figures in profile with human or human-like imagery and banded/sign-like decoration on an upright surface. The biggest difference is that A is a crowded register-like composition with many distinct creatures, including bird-like and scorpion/snake-like forms, while B is dominated by a single anthropomorphic body with arms/hands and only a few much less prominent animal or sign motifs.
